result.title: StepX-OPD: Rethinking Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Diffusion Models
result.summary: A deployable text-to-image diffusion model must hold several capabilities at once, such as instruction following, text rendering and human preference, and must sample in a few steps. Capabilities and few-step sampling are built in separate stages: a full-step model first consolidates capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, then serves as a fixed teacher for step distillation. Every full-step model we evaluate scores lower once compressed, and the second stage cannot begin until the first finishes. We introduce StepX-OPD, which merges the two stages: one student acquires every capability while learning to sample in a few steps, so frozen specialists supervise it on the states its own rollout visits rather than on a longer trajectory it never runs. Because a decomposition of the rollout's KL weights velocity mismatch most heavily near the clean end, we also regress the student's velocity on the low-noise part of the rollout. Separately, we find that capability integration makes models write prompt words into images on prompts that never asked for text, and we give a variant that lowers it. We evaluate on SD3.5-Medium and FLUX.1-dev across instruction following, text rendering, image quality and human preference. On both architectures, StepX-OPD attains the highest normalized average score among the four-step methods compared and exceeds the forty-step Flow-OPD model, and on SD3.5-Medium it trains with about 37% fewer GPU-hours than sequential DiffusionOPD followed by step distillation.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 StepX-OPD，把多教师 on-policy 蒸馏与少步采样蒸馏合并为一个阶段，让多个冻结的专用模型在学生自身 rollout 所访问的状态上监督学生，并额外对 rollout 低噪声段做 velocity 回归；在 SD3.5-Medium 与 FLUX.1-dev 上评估指令跟随、文字渲染与人类偏好。
AI.relevance_reason: 属图像生成领域，不直接研究 VLM 推理；但「在学生自身轨迹状态上施加教师监督」及按轨迹分段加权回归的做法，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练、监督分配与状态级蒸馏提供可核查的方法线索。
